title: Account failover, hibernation, and faster reloads
highlights: Automatically retry turns on the next pool account when one hits a usage limit, including for Desktop and SDK clients
Hibernate idle sessions to free memory, with measured RAM status and transparent wake on the next interaction
Reload and resume large sessions much faster by showing the local transcript immediately and sending only new history
improvements: Support OpenAI Ultrafast speed tiers for GPT-6.1 Sol, with Fast commands and hotkeys that apply promptly
Show saved accounts, cached quotas, and available resets in the startup account router and usage cards
Polish usage cards with responsive gauges and compact Mil and Bil token totals
Offer additional OAuth accounts in the login picker and reauthenticate saved accounts from it
Show cache misses inline with more accurate cache reuse diagnostics
Compress OpenAI and Anthropic request bodies to reduce upload time
Build the /model picker off the UI thread for large remote catalogs
Reconnect only changed MCP servers instead of restarting all of them
Simplify swarm mode by removing the task graph and defaulting swarm root effort to low
fixes: Keep startup headers and account rows on a single line at narrow widths
Show usage-limit rejections clearly instead of stale quota bars
Fix forked sessions failing on replayed Anthropic web search blocks
Count Gemini thinking and tool-use tokens correctly in usage
Keep streamed OpenAI output when the completion payload arrives empty
Preserve token usage when requests are cancelled or fail
Fix Windows named-pipe connections hanging or failing on startup probes
Fix Firefox cold starts blocked by stale zombie processes
Collapse expanded pinned todos and restore overall progress display
